messages:
zara: Hi folks, just joined and hitting an odd one. WireGuard shows connected on my MacBook (Monterey) but when I try to `ssh -J zara@bastion-eu-1 git@repo.corp.redwood` it connects but large packfile transfers fail during push/clone. Small commands work fine. Any ideas?
leo: welcome! :wave: can you reproduce with `scp` a large file to an internal host to see if it's general TCP over wg0?
zara: yep, `scp bigfile.tar.gz internal-host:/tmp/` starts and then stalls at ~12MB and drops with `write: Broken pipe`.
netops: thanks. Two common culprits: MTU/path-MTU (esp on consumer routers that block ICMP 'frag needed') or UDP fragmentation causing the WireGuard packets to be dropped. Can you run `sudo tcpdump -i en0 icmp or icmp6` while reproducing to see if "Fragmentation needed" ICMPs are returned?
zara: ran it — nothing shows. My home router is an older ISP-provided model.
leo: try lowering wg0 MTU on your Mac: `sudo ifconfig wg0 mtu 1400` and retry the transfer. That often helps if PMTU discovery is broken.
zara: changed to 1400 and `scp` completed. Nice!
netops: sweet. We'll add that to onboarding tips. Longer-term fixes we can apply on the server side too:
- Enable TCP MSS clamping on our egress gateways so TCP connections inside the tunnel get MSS reduced automatically.
- For WireGuard we can also push a `MTU` option in the client config (e.g., `MTU = 1400`) so new profiles apply it.
leo: another wrinkle on macOS: some users have Docker Desktop VM that still hits public network paths and shows different DNS. If you use Docker or vms, also set MTU in the desktop app or configure the VM network.
zara: thanks. One more thing 14 I noticed: when I do `curl` to the internal docs it resolves to 10.45.x.x but sometimes my browser still goes to the public page (redirects). Is there a recommended host override for the session while on WG?
netops: quick options: 1) add a temporary /etc/hosts line pointing the FQDN to the internal IP while you9re debugging. 2) Use an SSH SOCKS proxy via bastion: `ssh -D 1080 zara@bastion-eu-1` and set your browser to SOCKS5 localhost:1080 so all traffic goes via the bastion. 3) We'll standardize domain routing on wg0 so corp.* resolves on the tunnel (we track this in ONB-820).
it-bot: Ticket ONB-820 created: "Home router PMTU causing WG TCP stalls for new hires" assigned to @netops.
zara: nice, SOCKS proxy trick works for the browser. For git I updated ~/.ssh/config with:
```
Host *.corp.redwood
  ProxyJump zara@bastion-eu-1
  User git
```
then `git clone git@repo.corp.redwood:team/tooling.git` just worked (after MTU change).
support: adding note to the new-hire checklist: "If on consumer/home ISP and large transfers fail, set WireGuard MTU to 1400 or request a templated profile with MTU=1400. Use SOCKS proxy via bastion as fallback"
zara: thanks everyone, really appreciate the fast help. Happy to file steps I did into the onboarding doc if that helps new joiners.
leo: please do! Small, practical tips like this save time. :rocket:
